Third party assets used in Escape the Clocktower
All free / public domain (CC0) unless noted.

Poly Haven (CC0) - https://polyhaven.com
  Models: grandfather clock, bookshelf, desk drawer, tables, chairs, lamps, clocks,
  pocket watch, books, candlestick, suitcase, cabinets, tool chest, crates, wrenches,
  barrel stove, pipes, lanterns, barrels, ladder
  Textures: old wooden floor, decrepit wallpaper, damaged plaster, castle brick,
  old stone wall, rusty metal, wood plank wall, roof planks, metal grate, medieval wood

Kenney (CC0) - https://kenney.nl
  Furniture Kit, RPG Audio, Impact Sounds

Gear Pack by Elegant Crow - https://opengameart.org/content/gear-pack
  (credit not required, given anyway)
